checks: Context tabs, exact numeric dimensions, fine keyboard increments and Escape cancellation use semantic history.
Chimneys, planting and interior finishes have independent controls; generated benches can be hidden and reset.
Real window drags on four fixtures report frame intervals, render submission, long tasks and memory with explicit latency limits.
Generated path gates remain derived and can be hidden and undone.
Keeping a generated gate makes an editable opening that survives moving the path.
Automatic gate creation can be disabled and restored from the wall controls.
Facade and shutter controls preserve existing wall, roof, and ivy buffers.
An isolated wall edit preserves the other shape and its GPU buffers.
Roof-only reshaping preserves the wall geometry buffers.
Pointer reshaping commits one undoable edit; Escape restores the prior shape.
Opening authoring, movement, and removal update the preview.
The existing area material inspector assigns a finish to the new roof.
Bake saves the authored shape composition and material overrides.
Runtime restoration preserves the semantic composition.
Switching back to the existing workshop preserves freeform work.
The main radial workshop exposes Freeform shapes and its authoring controls.
Wall sliders support the complete legal height range.
Lowering a turret adapts elevated windows and undo restores both.
Descending traversal retains its negative rise in the visible controls.
Custom outlines remain visible and editable without ineffective resize controls.
Custom wall paths disable length and bend controls that cannot reshape the path.
Recovery cancels an unfinished edit and restores consistent committed history.
Baking completes a pending gesture once and saves the committed construction.
Craft dressing toggles locally without rebuilding masonry or ivy.
Bake saves the craft preference and keeps generated dressing out of authoring state.
Undo and redo deterministically restore and remove the crafted details.
Weathering changes reuse roof and ivy buffers.
Real window pointer drags commit once; undo, redo and Escape restore semantic cuts.
Curve handles author stable control points through real pointer events and replay.
Moving and hiding an individual chimney preserves other buffers and survives bake and renderer recovery.
All five architectural features can be added, resized with their host, removed, restored and baked through authoring controls.
A connected ramp inherits timber while a railing override preserves floor inheritance.
A real door drag moves its semantic opening, preserves windows and supports undo/redo.
Individual planters move and hide through pointer and authoring controls with semantic replay.
A footprint point drag authors a custom curve and survives undo/redo.
Five measured interactive opening edits and the settled upgrade preserve neighboring GPU products.
Four shutter poses edit through the UI, rebuild only the facade and replay correctly.
Balconies, bays and dormers move through real pointer drags, with one history command and Escape cancellation.
A curved balcony can be added, removed and restored using authoring controls.
Balcony intent and authored shutter poses survive bake and renderer recovery.
Both balcony presets retain their structural silhouette with fewer vertices at coarse detail.
